new: A photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN or passport) for the site register

Closed shoes: the visit includes the show flat and a construction walk
ready: A photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN or passport) for the site register
Your home-loan sanction letter, if you have one
Your floor and facing preferences, so the team can open the right flats
resale: A photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN or passport)
Your home-loan pre-approval, if you have one
Any questions for the owner: the relationship manager joins you
rent: A photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN or passport)
Your office ID or offer letter, which owners usually ask for
No money: nothing is collected at a visit
